resources.string: Your own space for media. Download, organize and keep video and audio on your device.
Created by Boran. Open source, without ads or mandatory accounts.
Tap this button to check the latest stable version on the official GitHub Releases page. Checking does not automatically download or install anything.

This package is updated through F-Droid. Use the F-Droid client for updates with the same signature and package name. GitHub APK releases are not offered as replacements for this installation.
This is a preview or a different package variant. Update it manually using a build with the same package name and signature; a stable APK is not offered as a replacement.
Downloading and conversion happen on your device. ZenithW does not upload your media to its own download server. History, preferences and any session cookies you use stay on your device.
The source website is contacted to prepare and download a link. Optional features such as SponsorBlock and engine updates contact their respective services. You control the files you save.

yt-dlp handles media information and downloads; FFmpeg handles conversion, audio processing and artwork embedding in supported formats. These tools run directly on your device through Android libraries.

ZenithW Android source code is available under AGPL-3.0. yt-dlp, FFmpeg, aria2 and other dependencies belong to their respective developers and have their own licenses. The source repository includes license and build information.
You never have to contribute. A small donation can help with development and server costs. ZenithW will not force you to sign up or pay.
